item.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
item.summary: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric. Bitcoin (BTC) returned to $64,000 after Monday’s Wall Street open as US stocks gave way to gold. Key points: Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD up by more than 2% on the day, rebounding from Sunday’s weekly close. Read more
